This lets, for example, user-video and video-hour interactions use different latent coordinates without adding fields, a deep branch, or materially more embedding capacity. Four post-parent signal changes (history, staged click, staged censored watch time, and temporal weighting) failed, while the harness recommends architecture. The implementation is an inspired field-conditioned extension of the standard FM, not an exact reproduction of a cited architecture: for fields f<g it scores sum_k gate[f,g,k] * V[x_f,k] * V[x_g,k]. Gates start at one, preserving the parent's initial function, and add only 15*16 trainable values. Training examples, pair sampling, batches, and update counts match the parent, avoiding the major loss/update confound. Validation early stopping still selects checkpoints solely on valid.
